The '''Bofa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bofa II]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-colonized planet which served as a distribution area for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|intelligence droids]]. Its relationship, if any, with the [[Bofa fruit/Legends|bofa]] fruit and [[bofa treat]] are unknown.
